mainEntity.name: How do I choose between repair companies for sale prep or rental prep?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing repair providers, look at response time, finish quality, experience with drywall and restoration work, and whether they can match existing materials and textures. For Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, local coverage also matters because faster access usually helps when timelines are tight.
